patch_description: Remove the global triangle-benefit floor of 1.2 and activate coordinated dense formation whenever triangle benefit is at least twice the actor's own cost on both layers. This extends the successful mechanism to low-cost d=0.4 and d=0.8 conditions while retaining original behavior for high-cost actors where densification is unsafe. In a clique, adding an edge at degree k has approximate local gain 1-c(2k+1)+dk; when d=2c this remains positive by 1-c, before any overlap benefit. Acceptance uses the same actor-local criterion, so actors whose post-shock costs are too high do not indiscriminately support densification.
